unit.title: Present Simple: Yes/No Questions with Do and Does
unit.overview: Build on affirmative and negative present-simple sentences by learning how to ask and answer basic yes/no questions with do and does.

objectives: Understand the role of do and does in present-simple yes/no questions.
Form questions with Do/Does + subject + base verb.
Give short positive and negative answers accurately.
Use everyday routine vocabulary to ask and answer simple questions.
Reinforce subject-verb matching and the preposition in live in + city through targeted practice.

focus: Yes, I/you/we/they do. / No, I/you/we/they don't.
Yes, he/she/it does. / No, he/she/it doesn't.
Keep the main verb in the base form after do/does
Match the subject and pronoun correctly when forming and answering sentences
Use live in + city/country correctly: live in Tokyo, live in New Zealand

grammar: Identify do/does, subject, and main verb in questions.
Choose Do or Does for different subjects.
Correct questions that incorrectly use a third-person -s after does.
Transform affirmative statements into yes/no questions.
Match questions with correct short answers.
Targeted subject-matching drill: choose the correct subject/pronoun for the intended action and correct mismatches such as He doesn't go home when the intended subject is She.
Targeted preposition drill: complete and produce sentences using live in + city/country, including correction of errors such as live Tokyo -> live in Tokyo.
vocabulary: Match everyday activity words with meanings.
Use core vocabulary in simple questions and answers.
Review Unit 1 and Unit 2 vocabulary in questions.
Use live in + city/country in questions and answers so the preposition is practised, not only recognised.
output: Ask five simple yes/no questions about daily routines.
Answer routine questions using accurate short answers and complete sentences.
Include at least one subject-matching question/answer pair and one live in + city/country question/answer pair.

grammar: At least 8/10 correct on Do/Does question formation and short answers.
No unresolved subject-matching error in the targeted reinforcement items.
Correctly use live in + city/country in the targeted item.
vocabulary: Correctly use at least 7 Unit 3 target/review words in context.
output: Produce at least 5 understandable present-simple yes/no questions and answers independently.
